AIToolbox · application shell · assistant side panel · spec Assistant panel: flow and motion The assistant opens as a custom inline block beside the page, under the header: a split view with a resizable divider, never a drawer or an overlay. Two header triggers with distinct jobs, a resizable divider, one pair of motion curves. Frames below are captured from the interactive prototype.
0What changesFrom the build in the photo: the panel, the divider and both buttons already exist; these are the corrections.
Both buttons do the same thingEach trigger has one job. The assistant button opens and closes the panel. Ask sends what is typed in the search field to the assistant; with an empty field it opens the panel and puts the cursor in the composer. Enter in the field still searches.
The panel stays light in the dark themeThe assistant is a custom inline block beside the page (not a drawer or side sheet) on surface-container-low in both themes (#FAF4FF light, #1D1A27 dark), separated from the page by the divider.
No header in the panelHeader with the Chatbot mark, “Assistant”, the page context (“Sweep · Runs”), New conversation and Close (Esc). The mark plays its once motion when the panel opens.
Hand cursor and a teal grip on the dividerKeep the grip always visible, as in your build, but as a 6 × 40 pill in outline on the 1 px divider, with a 12 px hit zone and the col-resize cursor. On hover (100 ms) or keyboard focus the line becomes 2 px primary and the grip grows to 48 px in primary; teal stays reserved for AI content.
No visible state on the assistant buttonSelected = nav-active pill and aria-expanded="true"; the tooltip switches between “Open assistant ⌘J” and “Close assistant ⌘J”. Writing with the panel closed: typing dots on the icon; answer waiting: neon dot.
“Coming soon” is a dead end for AskWhile the assistant is not live, Ask is disabled (aria-disabled, stays focusable) with the reason in a tooltip, so typed text is never sent nowhere. The assistant button still opens the panel on a proper empty state with “Tell me when it’s ready”.
Error copy (runs table)“Failed to load runs · Please try again.” → “Couldn’t load runs” + what happened, when it is known (for example “The runs service didn’t answer.”) + Retry. Same state mark B.

Spec
OpenWidth transition on the panel, 300 ms, cubic-bezier(.05, .7, .1, 1) (MD emphasized decelerate). The panel’s inner column already has its final width and is clipped, so text never re-wraps while it grows.
Close200 ms, cubic-bezier(.3, 0, .8, .15) (emphasized accelerate); the content fades first (100 ms) so the panel closes empty.
AskThe typed text slides up 8 px and fades (150 ms) out of the field; the bubble rises 8 px and fades in (200 ms) in the panel, 180 ms after the open starts.
Narrow window (under 840 px)The block takes the page area in place (no slide, no scrim): the page hides and the block content fades in, 150 ms; the header button gives the page back.
Reduced motionNo slide and no width animation: the panel appears at its width with a 150 ms fade; bubbles appear without rising; marks show their static state.
NeverAnimate the width while dragging; bounce or overshoot the panel; animate the page content separately from the panel.
5Themes, coming soon, narrow windowsThe block follows the theme; the empty state replaces the conversation while the assistant is not live; it stays inline at every width, never a drawer.
Darksurface-container-low #1D1A27 panel on the night page; same divider, same header.

Under 840 pxThe block takes the page area; the header button (or the NavigationBar Assistant tab on phones) gives the page back.

6Build notesFor the front-end implementation.
StructureA custom split layout, not a drawer: <div class="ait-split"> = <main> · divider · <aside id="assistant" aria-label="Assistant"> in one flex row (or grid 1fr auto var(--pw)); inert while closed. Angular: an ait-assistant-pane component and an aitSplitResize directive (pointer events + keyboard) on the divider; no MatSidenav / MatDrawer (no backdrop, no overlay mode, no focus trap).
TriggersAssistant button: aria-controls="assistant" aria-expanded. Ask: a button inside the search form, aria-disabled when not live. Global shortcuts ⌘J (toggle) and ⌘K (search field).
Stateopen, width (persisted per user), writing, unread, autoRail (the panel folded the drawer). The conversation lives outside the panel component so closing does not drop it.
CSSPanel width: 0 → var(--pw) with the transitions above; inner column width: var(--pw), overflow: hidden on the panel; .resizing on the app removes transitions during a drag.
PrototypeEvery rule on this board runs in the interactive prototype, with light / dark, live / coming soon and a 5× slow-motion switch: https://claude.ai/artifact/8wmNZqKPzJoExMsyYmasbt
